values.meaning: lockout duration before the dash-triggered second spin, and dash-buffer window
values.binNote: AmbessaE has no data value matching 0.225; the E slot's own rows list no lockout/dash-delay field, so this duration cannot be tied to a named bin row.

values.meaning: window after lockout ends in which the dash can still be buffered/initiated to trigger the second spin
values.quote: buffered during the lockout or initiated within {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the lockout ending
values.binNote: No matching data value in AmbessaE's rows; closest-named field 'Buffer_Dash_Forgiveness_Window' (0.275) exists only under AmbessaPassive, not AmbessaE.

mechanics.claim: Ambessa enters a 0.225-second lockout and spins to deal damage to nearby enemies and slow them.
mechanics.quote: '''Ambessa''' enters a {{fd|0.225}}-second {{tip|lockout}} and spins her twin drakehounds around her to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: If the dash follows the spin, Ambessa spins a second time at the end of the dash, applying the same damage again at no additional cost (no extra cooldown/cost).
mechanics.quote: she will spin a second time at the end of the dash to apply the same effects at no additional cost

mechanics.claim: The second spin occurs at wherever Ambessa is at the end of the dash, and happens even if the dash is interrupted.
mechanics.quote: '''Ambessa''' will cast the second spin of ''Lacerate'' from wherever she is at the end of the dash.
